LanguageData.LP_Leather_Bulette.label: bulette armored hide
LanguageData.LP_Leather_Bulette.description: Heavy armor plates from a bulette's back joined by tough hide. Very heavy and not very warm, but nearly impenetrable; good for armor.

LanguageData.LP_BuletteFlyer.label: bulette leap
LanguageData.LP_RustMonster.label: rust monster
LanguageData.LP_RustMonster.description: An insect-like monster with a rust-red carapace and a propeller-like tail that seeks metal to eat with two feathery antennae. Not especially aggressive, but once in a fight, metal weapons and metal armor it touches corrode rapidly: each hit makes the opponent's metal weapon in hand and one piece of metal armor lose 10% durability; striking it with a metal melee weapon rusts the weapon by 5% too. Wood, leather and bone are unaffected.
LanguageData.LP_GelatinousCube.label: gelatinous cube
LanguageData.LP_GelatinousCube.description: A nearly transparent cube of gel taller than a person, gliding slowly through damp places, engulfing everything in its path to slowly digest it; undigested bones, ironware and coins can often be seen inside. Melee hits have a 35% chance to engulf a target no bigger than itself whole: the engulfed is trapped in the gel, carried along, unable to move, and takes acid damage every second for up to 6 seconds; only defeating it rescues them (each cube can engulf only once every 10 seconds). Immune to acid itself, with no hide to skin. Nearly impossible to tame.
LanguageData.LP_Basilisk.label: basilisk
LanguageData.LP_Basilisk.description: An eight-legged giant lizard, slow-moving, its eyes glowing yellow-green. In a fight, enemies within 7 cells who can see it meet its gaze every second, their bodies gradually stiffening and slowing; when fully stiff they must endure it with Constitution (a failed save turns them to stone for half a day). The blind, mechanoids and other basilisks are unaffected. There are often lifelike "statues" near its den.
LanguageData.LP_Manticore.label: manticore
LanguageData.LP_Manticore.description: A lion's body, bat wings and a cunning human face, with a cluster of spikes at the tip of its tail. It flings tail spikes from a distance: with enemies in sight 3-15 cells away, it fires 3 tail spikes in a row every 8 seconds. At most 24 tail spikes; used ones regrow at one per hour.
LanguageData.LP_Bulette.label: bulette
LanguageData.LP_Bulette.description: A giant beast called the "land shark": heavily armored with a big armored fin rising from its back, it usually travels underground and bursts out of the earth when it smells prey. When enemies are 3-9 cells away it leaps high and crashes down (once every 15 seconds): those around the landing point take a heavy blow and are knocked down; the nimble can dodge half the damage and stay standing. Its armored hide makes excellent armor. Nearly impossible to tame.
LanguageData.LP_CarrionCrawler.label: carrion crawler
LanguageData.LP_CarrionCrawler.description: A horse-sized many-legged scavenger insect that often rummages for corpses in swamps and graveyards, with a ring of pink tentacles around its mouth. Each tentacle hit injects paralytic venom (a good Constitution can block it once): the more venom builds up, the number the body; when it fills up, the victim is fully paralyzed and collapses for 10 seconds.
